tours.title: BIRDING TOURS
overview: Overview : Welcome to WILD KUMAON, your premier destination for extraordinary birding tours. Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of avian wonders as we take you on unforgettable journeys to some of the most remarkable birding destinations in Kumaon and Uttarakhand.

At WILD KUMAON, we prioritize your safety, comfort, and satisfaction throughout your birding adventure. Our itineraries are carefully designed to maximize your birding opportunities while also providing time to soak in the natural beauty and tranquility of Sattal and around. Our expert guidance, comfortable accommodations, and seamless logistics make your birdwatching experience truly exceptional.
Whether you’re an avid birder, target oriented or a novice enthusiast. our itineraries cater to all levels of experience.

Our team of naturalists is not only knowledgeable but also deeply connected to the local birding community. This network allows us to stay informed about the latest bird sightings, ensuring that we always provide you with the most up-to-date information and the best opportunities to spot rare and sought-after species during our tours.
The benefits of our network of naturalists and their field sightings updates extend directly to you, our valued customers.

Ready to embark on an extraordinary birding adventure in Sattal and other regions of Uttarakhand? choose our tours here or contact us now to customize your dream birding tour and let us create a tailor-made experience that will leave you with memories to cherish for a lifetime.
tours.logistics: The Pick and Drop can be changed according to your requirement. in this Itinerary, the tour Starts from the nearest railway Station Kathgodam and also drop at the same point.

sessions.text: The first morning session we will be doing a bird hide session. this will provide us with many species and also there clear and good photographs. Hides or feeders are always good for Woodpecker and Thrushes.

Chanfi area has flowing streams and rivers, making it a very different habitat in comparison of Sattal and only place in the itinerary with a flowing water habitat. Thus many unique birds appear there.

itinerary.title: Ranibag
itinerary.intro: Ranibag is a part of the lower Himalayan foothill forest belt , extending from Haldwani to Kathgodam region. The area holds a mix of riverine, sal , and scrub forests , anad you may find some species not commonly seen in Jeolikote or Sattal .

sessions.text: Forest and riverine birding in Ranibag .
Ranibag adjoining woodland and forest edge

itinerary.title: Nainital Outskirt
itinerary.intro: Nainital Outskirt is a gem for finches and higher altitude small bird species.

sessions.text: Shyamkhet region. ShyamKhet is below the dense habitat of Ramgarh region, and is a home to finches, sunbirds and thrushes in the winters. as these birds migrates down when there is snowfall in the higher altitude and Shyamkhet is the perfect place to find them.
Pangot falls inside Naina Devi Wildlife Sanctuary and itself a destination for bird watchers, we will be spending one morning session here.
